internal_measurement.evaluator: material-only release validation; no new evaluator adopted
internal_measurement.results: Workspace release tests, all-feature release tests, Clippy with warnings denied, rustfmt, the optional opening-book build, Issue #130 Floodgate supervisor and actual-client regressions, a native material-only USI smoke, the 98.0112% engine/library line-coverage gate, WebAssembly package generation, Node WebAssembly tests, and WebAssembly package metadata validation passed. Post-authentication CSA run_error now terminates one-shot supervision without restart or fabricated game results. No general playing-strength claim is made.

external_opponents.configuration: No external engine, evaluator, weights, labels, Suisho5-derived scores, or Suisho5-derived opening positions are used as release evidence for v0.3.71.

known_limitations: No new NNUE checkpoint is bundled or adopted, and this release makes no general playing-strength claim.
The Issue #130 fix improves Floodgate failure handling but does not by itself prove playing-strength improvement.
The optional v0.3.38 checkpoint and its material-baseline recommendation remain unchanged.
Parallel search can vary by scheduler; deterministic diagnostics require one thread and SpecTopN=0.
The WebAssembly package is distributed as a GitHub Release asset and is not published to the npm registry.
Hosted CI remains the required browser-level WebAssembly check; local ChromeDriver returned HTTP 404 after the package, native, Node, and metadata checks passed.
External HalfKP inference remains optional and requires a separately obtained, license-compatible nn.bin file with its own provenance and operating scale.
